trace_format.note: All results must be collected from actual Agent execution; automated contract tests with synthetic records do not prove generation.

style_checks.linework: Visible continuous thin burin-like strokes, not just tinted smooth shading
style_checks.contour_hatching: Line directions follow water, mountains, folds and perspective
style_checks.cross_hatching: Shadow values use visibly controlled hatching density and crossing
style_checks.guilloche: Curved periodic/oscillating interlaces; not a Cartesian square grid
style_checks.limited_inks: Blue variant uses limited Prussian/steel blue + subdued accent; mono uses black/gray only
style_checks.subject_integrity: All required elements preserved/created and recognizable
style_checks.no_unrequested_text: No unsolicited lettering, denomination, watermark or border

evidence_semantics: each required_evidence key must be independently observed and true, with accompanying trace or reviewer record; do not prefill true before testing
